verdict.rationale: Blaxel provides sandboxes explicitly for isolated code execution, exposed via MCP tool calls, with scale-to-zero/resume infrastructure meaning execution happens off the developer's own infra, plus custom sandbox images and private preview URLs with tokens for security. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of isolation guarantees (e.g., security audits, escape testing) and explicit detail on resource/network sandboxing limits beyond docs claims.
